name: CBS time-series API · subject 44 "בינוי ונדל\"ן": building permits (44,11), construction starts (44,2), completions (44,3), active construction (44,4), stage indices (44,8), starts by purpose / renewal (44,2,5 · 44,2,6)
accessMethod: HTTPS GET, JSON, keyless (User-Agent required); same API, same response shape as the new-home sales series PROPX already reads (lib/cbs-sales/parse.js)
contains: Per series: id, time (3 month / 4 quarter / 1 year), data (1 original / 2 seasonally adjusted / 3 trend), unit, path (level1..level4 + name_id geography), update, obs[{TimePeriod, Value}]. Branches: 44,2 התחלות בנייה (dwellings by district 44,2,3; by purpose × district 44,2,5 — built for sale / of which subsidized / not for sale / purchase groups / for rent / self-build; demolition-rebuild & additions 44,2,6 — of which TAMA 38/2 + pinui-binui, TAMA 38 additions, demolished; floor area by use 44,2,1 / 44,2,7); 44,3 גמר בנייה (44,3,3 by district); 44,4 בבנייה פעילה (44,4,3 by district, quarterly stock); 44,5 months of construction per building; 44,8 indices 2015=100 for permits / starts / completions (1401/1402/1403); 44,11 היתרי בנייה (44,11,2 dwellings by district; 44,11,1 / 44,11,3 floor area by use); 44,7 civil engineering (pipes).

sample.series: 44,11,2,,275 permits, dwellings, Tel Aviv district (series 553824, monthly, original; 653824 annual)
44,2,5,1,275 starts built for sale, Tel Aviv district (573005 quarterly / 573037 annual)
44,2,6,2,2 starts in rebuilt buildings — of which TAMA 38/2 + pinui-binui, total (573114 quarterly / 573089 annual)
44,11,2,,1 permits, dwellings, total (553818 — the API returned the seasonally adjusted series first; the original series is in the same response)

geography: national + 7 CBS districts ONLY (level 5 of subject 44 = 269 nodes, every one of them a total or a district; no יישוב node). Geography codes differ by branch: 44,{2,3,4},3 → level-4 district nodes 1 ירושלים · 2 הצפון · 3 חיפה · 4 המרכז · 5 תל אביב · 6 הדרום · 7 יו"ש · 8 סך הכל (level 5 = 2 "סך הכל"); 44,2,5 / 44,2,6 / 44,11,2 → name_id 271..277 (+ 2 or 1 = total); sales 44,10,2,1 → 5069..5076; subsidized/second-hand sales → 7047..7053.
period: monthly from (at least) 2023-01 as read; the API serves earlier periods on request (startperiod); quarterly for active construction / starts by purpose / renewal starts; annual totals in the same response. Latest observation 2026-06 (monthly and Q2); series update 2026-09-10.
cadence: CBS quarterly construction release (≈ 10 weeks after the quarter) — monthly figures appear with the quarter; the API "update" field dates each series.
identifiers: CBS district code (name_id / level-4 code) — mapping to PROPX district rows is a fixed table like lib/cbs-sales/series.js GEOS; no locality code, no plan number, no parcel.
freshness: source-dated per series (update); a month is published ~10 weeks after the quarter ends; recent months revised in later releases (keep every version, as the sales ledger does).
licence: CBS terms of use (not stated in the API response); same terms PROPX already relies on for 44,10.
why: Official, machine-readable, district-level permits / starts / completions / active stock with 2026-06 observations — the exact "supply pipeline" figures the dossier and the supply block now lack (Trust Center has no permits or starts source). Same API + parser + ledger pattern as cbs-sales; a second sync lane (lib/cbs-construction) with its own geography table.
joinKey: CBS district (API name_id 271–277 / level-4 code 1–7 → PROPX district id, the same 7 districts as 5070–5076); national = total node. Never a locality.
evidence: https://github.com/kobi6061-hub/vizora/actions/runs/39062294494 (list level:2..5 of subject 44 — 4 catalogue pages, every HTTP 200)
https://github.com/kobi6061-hub/vizora/actions/runs/39062466627 (9 data/path reads, every HTTP 200, 2.2–11 KB JSON)
limitations: district only — a locality figure needs the CBS quarterly release PDF/XLS tables (not machine-readable, like sales by city)
permits ≠ starts ≠ completions: three universes, never summed
the first series in a response may be the seasonally adjusted one — select data.value = 1 (original) explicitly
geography code sets differ per branch — one table per branch, verified against the name
auditedBy: PROPX read-only discovery (GitHub Actions runner; scripts/*-discover.js)

sample.executorName: ארץ אשר אבניה ברזל יזמות בע"מ

geography: national; locality by NAME (city_name) — including regional councils ("מ.א. …"); no coordinates, no CBS code
period: current register of active sites (snapshot; work_id ascending ≈ notification order); closed sites with closure dates from 2023-08 → 2026-10

identifiers: work_id (stable per notification); executor_id ↔ contractors register MISPAR_KABLAN (exact); city_name ↔ geo registry locality name (normalise "תל אביב - יפו" → the CBS name; regional councils map to councils, not localities)

Counting active sites per locality (and residential ones where build_types says so) gives an OBSERVED construction-activity indicator with a daily ledger; the executor key ties it to the contractors register and, by exact name, to the developer registry ("possibly the same" rule).
joinKey: executor_id ↔ datagov:moch:contractors-register.MISPAR_KABLAN (exact); city_name ↔ data/geo locality name (exact after normalisation; label when the name is a regional council); site_name block/parcel text ↔ ILA lot GushHelka only when both numbers are explicit (never by fuzzy text)

https://github.com/kobi6061-hub/vizora/actions/runs/39063387888 (the Haifa portal's derived copy: same fields, 442 rows for Haifa)
limitations: a safety notification is not a permit, a start or a dwelling count — build_types is often empty and residential cannot always be told apart
locality is a free-text name; no address field, no geometry
no start date in the active table (snapshot only) — dates become PROPX-observed
sanctions / warrants fields are regulatory, not market signals
